mechanism_added_relative_to_v2: partner-level service quality heterogeneity independent of geography and introduced/native status; fixed introduced-partner penalty removed
interpretation: Allowing every partner, including novel partners, to vary broadly in per-partner service quality does not broaden positive lineage responses relative to v2 and leaves the mean oceanic response strongly negative. This falsifies service-quality heterogeneity as a sufficient missing mechanism under the current opportunity process. It may still matter jointly with other processes, but should not be tuned further in isolation.
next_gate: Diagnose which structural assumption forces decline bias before adding more biology. In particular, test whether the mainland many-partner accumulation rule creates an automatic numerical advantage that overwhelms partner quality and assurance. Use an ablation/null comparison before adding any new empirical mechanism.
claim_boundary: Synthetic mechanism test only. The result does not show that partner effectiveness is unimportant in nature; it shows that adding heterogeneous effectiveness to this specific model structure is insufficient to reproduce broad response branching.
